en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a brick railway station building with arched windows, a central entrance with columns and a small tower or spire above it. Horse‑drawn carts stand outside. There are handwritten messages in dark ink across the bottom and top, and in red print the word 'Jernvägsstationen' (railway station) and partly legible 'Korsland' appear on the image.
